The '''Senate Defense Council''', known also as the '''Defense Council''' or '''Council on the Common Defense''', was a council of the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]]. The Defense Council was charged with the oversight of the [[Defense Force]]. The Council approved funding for the Defense Force, and approved the [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]].

During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], [[Behn-kihl-nahm]] was chair of the Defense Council. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Fyg Boras]], [[Chau Feswin]], and the [[Senator of Bilbringi]] sat on the Council.
